reviewerOrPass: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Reconstructed the named compulsory credits from the adopted appendices, then checked the dated scheme, eligible elective entries and thesis progression before reassessing the frozen record and workbook evidence.
findings: The named courses give 60 EC in year one, 36 taught compulsory EC in year two and 18 taught compulsory EC plus a 12 EC thesis in year three. The regulation’s aggregate philosophy line does not name a separate 12 EC course. Appendix 1 and the dated guide both name a 6 EC Philosophy of the Humanities and a separate 6 EC Thesis Workshop. The dated guide shows 12 programme elective credits across years two and three, consistent with Appendix 2 eligibility and the assessment table’s years 2–3, plus 42 open EC. This closes 180 EC and exceeds the 30 EC free-choice minimum.

Aesthetics and Politics and Moving Images Across Media are the first two distinct 6 EC options common to the formal list and the guide. They fit block 1 of year two and block 2 of year three. The listed Banned Books and Disability, Race, Gender units are 12 EC and are not used to illustrate a single 6 EC slot. The thesis entry requires 120 EC before work with the supervisor and identifies the workshop as preparation. The full second year gives the needed credit. The year-three workshop precedes the regular thesis in blocks 5–6.

The three UCR sets were retained. Actual pairwise differences are 90, 37.5 and 105 EC each way. The closest option has deeper historical and visual-arts inquiry through art survey, Renaissance study, sociology and independent historical research. The screen option substitutes rhetoric and persuasion plus archaeology, environmental media and introductory philosophy. The identity and power option uses gender history, political thought, institutions and movements to study cultural expression.

Perspectives on Literary Meaning supports a direct overlap in critical frameworks. Introduction to Film & Media gives a bounded moving-image alignment. Art history and Media Archaeology remain useful courses without a direct one-to-one match for UvA cultural memory or contemporary concepts. UvA offers more sustained theory and an independent 12 EC thesis. Verified the 18 external components, 40 selected UCR titles and descriptions, three concepts, alignment rows, ten note anchors and official links. Optional UCR research remains outside scheduled credit.
